purpose: 2026-specific Invention additions and account-level component bottlenecks that materially affect League combat builds.

new_2026_component_routes.base_2026_source_rule: Jagex introduced the component with one component from Roar of Awakening, Ode to Deceit, Khopesh of Tumeken or Khopesh of Elidinis; the current Wiki category also includes later Amascut/Tumeken equipment.
new_2026_component_routes.planner_value: Desert has a self-contained Khopesh route to the component. Sanctum/Underworld locality is not forced into a region until Equilibrium publishes destination handling.

current_2026_perk_dependencies.pvme_result: Guaranteed in the current PvME recipe
current_2026_perk_dependencies.wiki_alternative: 7 Ecliptic is a guaranteed single-perk Equilibrium 4 route; 6 Ecliptic is approximately 98.97% before adding combo materials.
current_2026_perk_dependencies.style_relevance: PvME's current advanced Necromancy armour setup uses Equilibrium 4 in place of a crit-oriented Biting setup because Equilibrium prevents critical strikes.
region_pressure: desert can self-source Ecliptic through Khopesh progression
other Ecliptic sources may reduce region pressure if their Equilibrium locality is available

current_2026_perk_dependencies.planner_value: Lower-tier bridge that makes Manufactured supply relevant even before Ecliptic-heavy Equilibrium 4 setups.

current_2026_perk_dependencies.pvme_result: Guaranteed at 76+ Invention in the current PvME recipe.
current_2026_perk_dependencies.planner_value: Cheap bridge recipe and a direct proof that Manufactured is part of the live 2026 Equilibrium material ladder.

account_component_routes.example_return: Seasinger items give 3 Oceanic components each; level-9 augmented Seasinger robe bottoms can give 12.
account_component_routes.planner_value: This is primarily a Player-Owned Ports time/account bottleneck rather than an elective-region bottleneck. Treating it as a region drop would make no-trading build estimates wrong.
